name: Futaai Akane
source:
Akane is a university student studying history. She was hoping to relax during the summer holidays, but after her mother collapsed at work, Akane decides to help her family business until her mother gets better. Everything was normal until she discovers a letter addressed to her mother, which revealed that Akane is actually adopted. Shocked, Akane is torn between finding out the whole truth and the fear of finding out things that would be better left untouched. 

Sully claims that she summoned him, but Akane has no knowledge of doing so. At first, working in place of her mother is tiring and stressful, but she adjusts before she knows it. Her kind, caring and hardworking nature makes her well suited to her post.
